purpose: Bounded development-only 2x2 diagnosis of input block scale and relative upgrade-gain learning

gain.loss: mean MSE over eight non-reference heads, without reweighting or resampling

selection.tie_break: lower nominal cost, then lower action index
selection.ensemble: arithmetic mean of three seed outputs before choosing action

evaluation.primary_mechanism_metric: within-image AUC on the identical mixed-outcome image subset for all four groups
evaluation.uncertainty: paired image bootstrap, 2000 draws, seed 20260922; conditional on fitted checkpoints
contrasts: scale effect averaged across both targets
target/loss effect averaged across both scales
evaluation.tests: paired image sign-flip for AUC and utility contrasts, 10000 draws; Holm over 3 contrasts x 2 metrics x 2 development splits; exploratory only
evaluation.seed_reporting: all three seeds and ensemble, never best seed
evaluation.baseline_reproduction: original_absolute refit must match original joint9 probabilities within 1e-6 and all selected actions; otherwise stop and diagnose before interpreting intervention

decision.mechanism_signal: Report paired effect directions and intervals on both development splits; do not select a winner post hoc or infer a single causal root
decision.system_screen: Reuse EXP-012 accuracy/resource/utility/seed gates unchanged for each group; passing is exploratory and full-cost gate remains pending
decision.stop: Deliver all four groups plus controls and a bounded conclusion. No additional fits, lambda sweeps, test300 access, SNR runs, or manuscript changes in this task.

limitations: Both validation and legacy_dev have been repeatedly inspected; neither is a fresh independent test.
Target factor changes parameterization, loss, and checkpoint loss together; it does not isolate target wording alone.
Dimension-based block scaling is an optimization intervention, not proof that image evidence causally suppressed question understanding.
Accuracy is cached noiseless receiver correctness; symbol counts do not imply measured delivery or energy.
